messages:
sara: Heads-up — we're rolling a RBAC policy refactor into the private control plane tomorrow morning that changes how the 'onprem-admin' cluster role maps to service accounts. I want to call out potential impacts on Dedicated customers using VPC allowlists and KMS-bound keys.
kevin: Thanks. Which binding specifically? the new role removes some legacy verbs?
sara: Right — it consolidates two roles into 'infra.admin.v2' and drops direct 'kms:Decrypt' from the cluster-level binding. The expectation is teams will use the new per-tenant KMS binding instead.
maria: Customer X just pinged support saying they lost access to the audit logs UI earlier today — could be related.
diana: If the control plane no longer has cluster-level kms decrypt, onprem audit exporters that sign envelopes with control-plane keys will fail. Need to confirm fallback policy.
omri: Can we gate the rollout behind a feature flag per-tenant? If not, we should at least ship a temporary allowlist patch.
sara: We can. Plan: gate by tenant annotation (private.rw.role_migration=opt-in). For tenants without opt-in we keep legacy binding for 48h and emit deprecation events to logs.
kevin: Add an audit log hook that records failed kms ops and includes the service-account name and request id. That'll help triage.
sara: Agreed — adding: 
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: controlplane-audit-filters
data:
  log_on_kms_fail: "true"
```
kevin: Also verify network path: VPC allowlist might prevent control plane from reaching customer KMS endpoints if IPs changed after deployment. Confirm routes and egress IPs.
diana: I ran a quick smoke: controlplane -> customer-kms: TIMEOUT in prod region eu-west-1 at 09:12 UTC. Logs show TLS handshake aborted.
omri: That smells like egress IP change. deploy-bot: rolling deploy started for infra-controlplane:v2 at 09:05 UTC (id: deploy-231999).
sec-bot: Incident candidate flagged: HIGH - potential customer-key access regression affecting 3 tenants.
sara: Triage actions: 1) Pause rollout (omri), 2) Re-add cluster-level kms:Decrypt for any tenants that report failures (diana), 3) Open postmortem ticket and attach audit traces (kevin).
omri: Paused rollout, everyone stop new traffic to canary hosts.
diana: Re-adding cluster-level binding now for impacted tenants, pushing patch.
kevin: I created an eval query for audit logs: 
```
index=audit | where action="KMS:Decrypt" and status!="OK" | stats count() by service_account, tenant_id
```
maria: I'll loop in support and CSMs, notifying affected customers and offering rollback if needed.
sara: After rollback we need a longer-term fix: document migration steps for customers with onprem exporters, update console UI to show per-tenant KMS status, and add an automated preflight that checks egress IPs vs customer allowlists before switching role bindings.
kevin: Agree. Add a regression alert to fire if failed KMS ops > 5 in 10m.
omri: Logged runbook item: controlplane-rbac-rollback-231999.md.
sara: Thanks all — keep updates here. If anyone sees new KMS failures, paste trace ids.
kevin: Found one trace id: trace-6632a9b4. Adding to ticket #SEC-482.
diana: Patch applied and verified for tenant-42, KMS decrypt success at 09:38 UTC.
sara: Closing the immediate loop; leaving feature flag timeline open (48h) and scheduling a security review next week. :thumbsup:
